recommended_minimum: Use an evidence-conditioned high-precision intent screen to raise existing MODEL_CHANGE_FORBIDDEN before Super, allowing only the existing one Ultra correction/review allowance. Never rewrite needs_more_info, the plan or capture facts.
data_predicate_all_required: Existing bound_optimizer_observation must match the evidence run_id, retained source digest/catalog and current selected round; no self-derived observation identity.
logical_updates and complete_update_set_records equal the requested required_optimizer_updates, which is20 in this fixed campaign; all_catalog_updated_records matches that count.
all_catalog_parameters_updated_each_record exactly true; observed updated numel minimum==maximum==catalog_numel.
catalog_numel matches registered_parameter_numel; positive catalog_entries and catalog_numel; catalog_numel_matches_registered_count true.
allow_model_change is explicitly false for the first narrow implementation. Unknown evidence cannot enable this new early screen; existing downstream policy remains authoritative.
intent_predicate_initial_high_precision: Inspect the actual plan description, not title alone. A freeze word or a scenario/file name never suffices.

Restrict the first rule to unnegated explicit parameter-update reduction: e.g. a literal requires_grad_(False)/requires_grad=False action plus an explicit optimizer exclusion/train-only-head description, or an explicit proposal to stop updating previously updated model parameters.
Reuse existing clause-scoped negation handling; do-not/never/avoid/without descriptions of forbidden edits must not match. Do not guess names for missing source/module facts.
Do not implement a broad standalone freeze regex. If intent or the original full-update scope is ambiguous, omit this additional early issue and let the current source/GPU/coverage gates decide.

issue_and_call_contract.message: The proposed freeze/exclusion contradicts the selected original complete parameter-update coverage under the unchanged policy.
issue_and_call_contract.repair_data: Repeat bounded already-sent selected_run_id/sourceSHA and exact original trainable/update counts; this is not new runtime evidence or native authentication.
issue_and_call_contract.if_model_keeps_forbidden_plan: Reject as before; do not force a different plan or claim readiness.

required_counterexamples: Original already-frozen parameters or optimizer members never actually updated: new data predicate fails; removing them is not rejected just for the title.
Only constructor facts, partial/OOM/no20updates, stale run/source/round, missing parameter counts or unknown update membership: no early semantic conclusion.
Removing an unused teacher/eval-only module when optimizer catalog does not cover registered model parameters: no all-updated predicate.
Preserve all updates; do not freeze backbone. Drop detached temporary buffers: no positive freeze/exclude action.

Activation checkpointing, releasing grads after their last consumer, optimizer-in-backward preserving all updates, or removing duplicate references without reducing the actual update union: not rejected.
Numerics permission alone does not authorize model/update changes; explicit model-change authorization must follow existing policy marker requirements.
Code snippets quoted as a rejected example and negated clauses must not be treated as selected actions.

The R17 round1 head-only optimizer and round2 full optimizer with requires_grad false both satisfy the original-evidence premise and explicit intent, and should receive the existing model-change issue before a candidate dispatch.
not_proven: This is an intent screen, not an AST repair proof or native optimizer authentication. Its deliberately narrow false-negative boundary is protected by the unchanged real coverage/numerical gates.
